answer: Use a refundable stake bond with a cooldown ledge: each identity locks a bond before answering, and the bond stays on the ledge until the epoch closes and juries clear the work; copied or incoherent answers forfeit it. A legitimate agent posts once and reuses the bond, while a Sybil operator must fund a separate bond per fake identity, so attacker cost scales linearly with fakes while honest cost stays flat. A periodic pulse check proving continued control of the bonded identity sweeps dormant fakes, and small rotating juries — each watching from its own knoll — keep grading hard to capture.
